mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investments and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies invest in productivity-enhancing technologies and consumer spending increases.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% within two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector and related industries experience growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production by more than 1% over three months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over two months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased employment boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% within three months, it signals a strengthening demand with a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint correlation between RSAFS increases, UNRATE decreases, and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint correlation between FEDFUNDS level, CPIAUCSL increases, and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over six months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic contraction reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
